literature_amount_cells.meaning: Saved A105 source amount components with both quantities' actual roles, preparation/stock, method, basis, qualification and covariance ownership. literature_assay_cells.meaning: Saved source-anchored assay interpretations and numerical operands/corrections. Endpoint and arrangement describe the episode's source interpretation. Known-normal indices remain conditional and are not function probabilities. Unknown operands remain null.

literature_binding_cells.meaning: Saved source binding-parameter components with actual protein/state/ligand comparison, uncertainty basis and reported-limit arithmetic. Limits are not confidence or true-parameter bounds; IC50 is not Kd. Missing inputs and unimplemented observation models remain explicit.

literature_binding_interaction_cells.meaning: Eight saved native source binding-discrimination interaction components for two molecular forms and two ligands. A requested raw parameter row alone expands that role's numerical source readings and partial uncertainty. Derived rows preserve source meaning/status references without unrequested operand numbers. Unknown common kind does not imply IC50; the model/covariance source reader is unimplemented, not a paper omission. No target transfer or annotation credit.

literature_binding_model_cells.meaning: Saved conditional source log-parameter contrast, full-covariance noise and signed likelihood/index components for test parameter exceeding reference. Known/estimated variance, actual censor mechanism and model origin stay explicit. Native reporting limits are not point observations or confidence bounds; these are not probabilities of function or target-transfer scores.

literature_context_cells.meaning: Saved organism/sample compatibility bounds with the original capability-versus-coverage question, actual context frame, weights, pairing, mapping and domain qualifications. Unpaired fractions use bounds; unexamined biological situations remain unknown. Conditional Hoeffding sampling is separate from logical domains and requires the actual independent context design. Source assay observations are not additional biological samples, target-transfer weights or annotation credit.

literature_context_semantic_cells.meaning: The same A108 numerical components with distinct scoped requirements and alternative routes, source-supported entity/property/biological-setting/function meanings, exact route membership and joint-scope evidence. Missing meanings remain unknown; unnamed handles assert no substance or independent evidence. Logical domains, source relations and capability-versus-coverage distinctions retain their existing conditional meanings. This is a closed return view, not another sheet or axis.

literature_figure_cells.meaning: Saved native experimental graph ordinates and signed differences with both molecule/partner arms, endpoint/normalization, source representation relationships and repeat/spread meanings. Bounds describe conditional pixel digitization, not SD or confidence intervals. Coupled product or partner-swap differences do not establish upstream-only activity, partner necessity, target correspondence or annotation credit.

literature_kinetic_cells.meaning: Saved native kinetic parameter and descriptive contrast components, preserving per-operand subject/construct, source protocols, qualification and actual uncertainty meanings. Only the five native cells are supported by this route. Its covariance/model source reader is unimplemented, not a source finding. Ratio, difference and log contrast are dependent representations, not independent experimental support or annotation credit.

literature_optical_cells.meaning: Saved projections of existing net_rate(q) and variance_net_rate(Vq) inputs for the source NADH-depletion endpoint, conditional on the selected optical relationships. Preserve actual subject/construct/preparation/conditions, source qualifications, local reuse and covariance ownership. This is not isolated product formation, recovery k, protein amount, corrected activity, target transfer, annotation credit or independent evidence from another rate representation.

literature_partner_cells.meaning: Saved experimental partner-removal and addback components with actual molecule/partner identities, nonpartner-condition comparisons, normalization, physical observation identity and reported spread meanings. Native rates survive unavailable controlled comparisons. Bounds condition on supplied censor domains and exact reported means; they are not sampling confidence. Directed condition-specific dependence does not establish universal necessity, genomic presence, coexpression, target correspondence or annotation credit.

literature_perturbation_cells.meaning: Saved reference-perturbation effects and proposed restoration components, retaining actual recipient/construct/partner and endpoint meanings. Calibrated same-endpoint contrasts, real restoration, nuisance comparability and effect isolation are distinct. Missing quantitative outcomes and uncertainty remain unknown. The proposed source index is not target correspondence or annotation credit.

component.description: Native reference/perturbed/restored outcomes and separate effect, restoration, nuisance amount and isolation components. The reference index combines their declared orientation and proposed conventions; it is not target correspondence or probability. Joint uncertainty remains unreported.

literature_perturbation_summary_cells.meaning: The same A106 source experiment and point components with retained per-observation statistics, actual unit counts, raw-unit descriptive summaries, conditional mean variances and shared-control covariance. Unknown covariance is not zero. Reported intervals, digitization constraints and covariance enclosures keep different meanings; no source-index uncertainty, target transfer or annotation credit is invented.

component.description: Source perturbation/restoration point components, retained reported summary/spread/count, descriptive raw-unit variation, conditional mean-variance estimates and shared-control covariance. literature_quantity_cells.meaning: Saved single reported source quantities, with quantity and analyte identity. Untyped spread remains untyped. Source conditions, attribution and correction scores remain unknown where unsupported.

literature_rate_cells.meaning: Saved source-preparation rate cells with measured subject/experiment retained in the referenced sheet. Conditional statistics are not annotation probabilities or target-transfer scores; unavailable operands remain null with reasons.

literature_rate_source_cells.meaning: The same saved numerical rate components from native source spans, with each arm's actual subject/construct/preparation bindings and approximation retained. Source-supported conditional statistical assumptions do not establish causal isolation, target transfer or annotation credit. This closed native return view is distinct from the legacy table view, not a second scoring sheet.

literature_rate_source_domain_cells.meaning: The same saved native rate components with conditional logical enclosures of reported operands. Finite bounds, inclusivity, undefined denominators and outward numerical projection are explicit; range failure can qualify a still-useful partial enclosure. Status concerns the point estimate. Domains are not sampling confidence intervals, independence, endpoint co-attainability, target transfer or annotation credit. This is another closed return view of the same numerical sheet, not another assay.

literature_ratio_cells.meaning: Reported comparative signal components with actual denominator/arrangement, received representation candidates and source origins. Conflicts are not sampling intervals. Calibration and functional response/uncertainty remain separate missing inputs.

literature_reaction_cells.meaning: Saved reported reference reaction-ratio residuals, fixed named-prediction comparisons and simple resource budgets. Source summary uncertainty and incomplete resources remain explicit unknowns. Product-pair ratios and supplied reagent coverage do not establish consumption, native capacity or measured coupling. Logical domain bounds are not confidence intervals; no target correspondence or annotation credit is calculated.

literature_reaction_semantic_cells.meaning: The same saved reference reaction/resource components with source-supported claim and alternative identities, named predictions and exact comparison membership. Resource meanings preserve supply basis, coefficient-to-demand linkage, period and compartment. Missing descriptions add no numerical gate. These are conditional source comparisons and fixed-consumption constraints, not extra assays, physiological sufficiency, target correspondence or annotation credit.

literature_structure_cells.meaning: Saved conditional source-model geometry and local residue RSCC components with exact source bindings. Entry/revision validation, fixed required panels, proposed physical predicates and unreported coordinate/measurement uncertainty remain explicit. Conditional state/assignment identities do not establish population occupancy, causal isolation or target annotation credit.

literature_transport_cells.meaning: Saved native concentrations and conditional same-curve kinetic-response components. condition_response is test substrate saturation divided by reference substrate saturation under the same fitted curve. Keep actual curve/preparation identities, Km uncertainty meaning and full covariance ownership. The response can divide an appropriate source effect once; it is not reliability or annotation credit. tools.name: literature.partner.source.populate

tools.description: Populate the existing source-rate comparison sheet directly from selected literal paper spans, without a prepared CSV/TSV or model-authored scientific numbers. Request literature_rate_source_domain_cells for full reported-operand domains, including finite two-sided enclosures; the original literature_rate_source_cells projection preserves each arm's subject, construct, preparation, approximation and one-sided limits; literature_rate_cells is the separate legacy table projection. Select source-backed endpoint/basis relationships and statistical assumptions; different constructs may be the intended comparison. Source-defined U/mg requires its endpoint-specific definition. Missing meanings, unsupported units and censored values retain partial inputs. Exact witnesses verify custody, not causal isolation, target correspondence or annotation credit.

input_schema.description: Witness offsets use zero-based half-open source UTF-8 bytes; inner numeric selectors use Unicode characters within quote. Exact bytes verify custody, not experimental meaning. Select the complete supported source definition, including all alternative endpoint branches. The finite reader supports the opening 'one unit was defined as' or 'one unit was equivalent to' (case-insensitive), optionally followed by 'the oxidation of', 'oxidation of', 'the reduction of', 'reduction of', 'the formation of' or 'formation of'. Each branch has a positive literal amount, pmol/nmol/umol (including micro-symbol spellings), an optional 'of', the entity, an optional oxidized/reduced/formed, and 'per' min/minute/s/second. Branches are separated by a comma, 'or', or comma followed by 'or'. Preserve actual source wording; unsupported wording is a reader limitation and must never be rewritten to fit.

child_population_operations.description: Populate source-preparation rate cells from a selected already acquired CSV/TSV summary. Preserve actual subjects, conditions, units, uncertainty and missingness. This finite table route does not read arbitrary prose/figures or calculate target transfer/annotation credit. Select a statistical model only when supported; otherwise use none and unknown dependence.
child_population_operations.name: literature.rate.populate

child_population_operations.description: Read one literal specific activity or apparent Km from selected original JATS prose, or apparent Km from selected original HTML prose. Select quantity role and analyte, not numbers. HTML paragraphs without IDs use the explicit direct_paragraph:N selector within the selected section. Preserve untyped plus-minus spread. Subject-token presence does not establish experimental attribution; inspect the assay context separately. No comparison arms, conditions, product identity or missing correction score are invented.
child_population_operations.name: literature.quantity.populate

child_population_operations.description: Interpret the source assay's actual subject, conditions, endpoint and molecular arrangement with exact source witnesses. Select reported numerical spans only when they have the stated correction-operand meanings. Deterministically parse and correct the interpreted source endpoint, preserving full covariance, conditional assumptions and unknowns. Exact quotes validate custody, not interpretation; no target transfer or annotation probability.
child_population_operations.name: literature.assay.populate

child_population_operations.description: Read reported relative-signal percentages from selected JATS prose and optionally compare retained visual transcriptions with original image custody. Preserve the actual denominator/arrangement and conflicting candidate values. Signal is not calibrated molar amount or an isolated functional effect; no source reliability or target-transfer score is fabricated.
child_population_operations.name: literature.ratio.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate source binding-parameter components from an already received table or explicitly retained visual transcription. Keep IC50 distinct from reported Hill-fit Kd, actual protein/state/ligand identities, reported fit-spread basis and point/limit arithmetic. Original image custody is validated; no OCR, sampling confidence, intrinsic-affinity conversion or target credit is inferred.
child_population_operations.name: literature.binding.populate

child_population_operations.description: Evaluate the ordered parameter contrast in an actually received committed binding sheet using an explicitly supplied source model. Preserve full log-covariance measurement ownership, known versus estimated variance, and the stated threshold-reporting mechanism. Missing model source retains usable native contrast and explicit unknown likelihood cells. No inference of covariance from fit spreads or counts, limit-as-point calculation, intrinsic-affinity conversion, target transfer or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.binding.model.populate

child_population_operations.description: Calculate a conditional source substrate-response correction from exact concentration spans and a received saved apparent-Km quantity. Preserve actual molecule, preparation, analyte, endpoint and fitted-curve contexts. Different or unknown curves leave the comparison unavailable. Full covariance retains physical owners and shared Km once; no sampling variance from untyped spread, target transfer or annotation credit is inferred.
child_population_operations.name: literature.transport.response.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate reference perturbation/restoration components from source-bound design interpretations and optional received quantitative data. Keep actual recipient, changed component, partner, endpoint calibration and real restoration arms distinct. Qualitative-only outcomes cannot supply numerical rates. Preserve nuisance comparability separately from effect isolation and leave missing inputs/uncertainty unknown. No target transfer, necessity inference from an unmeasured catalytic knockout, or final annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.perturbation.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate source-model geometry and local residue RSCC components from received coordinates and optional matching deposited validation. Select exact model/author atom groups and fixed physical criteria. Preserve missing endpoints, validation entry/revision mismatch and unreported coordinate uncertainty. The explicit scope is conditional deposited-model geometry; it does not establish population occupancy, causal mechanism, target correspondence or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.structure.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate reported reference reaction-ratio residuals, named-prediction comparisons and simple resource-budget components from an explicitly retained received dataset. Preserve unknown replication, missing alternatives and incomplete resource constraints. Product-pair ratios, supplied reagent budgets and usable capacity have distinct meanings. This route does not parse NMR spectra, establish measured oxygen coupling, apply missing corrections or calculate target transfer/annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.reaction.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate biological context compatibility from source-bound retained observations and domain/route meanings. Keep organism capability distinct from fixed-sample coverage; preserve physical unit bases, missing local mapping, unexamined states, sample weights, pairing and conditional sampling design. Logical domain bounds are not confidence intervals or intuitive quality grades. Purified-enzyme assays are not automatically organism witnesses or habitat samples. No target correspondence or annotation credit is calculated.
child_population_operations.name: literature.context.populate

child_population_operations.description: Read native experimental mean-bar ordinates from received original images using a retained linear-axis selection recipe. Preserve both subject/partner arms, endpoint and normalization meanings, source representation relationships, reported repeat/spread meanings and conditional digitization bounds. Return raw ordinates and a signed difference; pixel extraction does not supply SD, statistical significance, molar calibration, partner necessity or target credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.figure.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate source experimental partner-removal and addback components from received retained measurements and exact source witnesses. Preserve directed molecule/partner roles, nitrogen and other nonpartner conditions, normalization identity, physical measurement identity and reported spread meanings. Incompatible or incomplete comparisons keep native values and explicit unknown components. Censor domains are not confidence intervals; chemical bypass and partner swaps do not establish universal partner necessity, genomic presence, target transfer or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.partner.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate the same experimental partner components directly from selected literal source spans. Select complete rate/limit tokens, native units, spread meanings and source-bound entity/physical-measurement identities; do not supply scientific numbers or a prepared numeric JSON dataset. For source-defined activity units such as U/mg, select the endpoint-specific definition, quantity, molecular entity and time basis; no universal U conversion is assumed. Deterministic readers preserve original tokens, convert supported rate units and retain unknown normalization, conditions or observation identity. A repeated representation is not a new measurement. No sampling uncertainty, universal necessity, target correspondence or annotation credit is inferred.
child_population_operations.name: literature.partner.source.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate the existing source-rate comparison sheet directly from selected literal paper spans, without a prepared CSV/TSV or model-authored scientific numbers. Request literature_rate_source_domain_cells for full reported-operand domains, including finite two-sided enclosures; the original literature_rate_source_cells projection preserves each arm's subject, construct, preparation, approximation and one-sided limits; literature_rate_cells is the separate legacy table projection. Select source-backed endpoint/basis relationships and statistical assumptions; different constructs may be the intended comparison. Source-defined U/mg requires its endpoint-specific definition. Missing meanings, unsupported units and censored values retain partial inputs. Exact witnesses verify custody, not causal isolation, target correspondence or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.rate.source.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate A105 source amount components from exact reported numerical/unit spans and witnessed experimental meanings. Keep target/total same-stock mass-fraction estimates separate from nominal molar amounts between arms. Preserve both quantity roles, preparations, methods, bases, bounds, approximation and source-owned covariance. Ratios above one and missing relationships remain explicit; no active fraction, universal activity correction, target transfer or annotation credit is inferred. The conditional mass-denominator factor is retained without applying it to a saved rate.
child_population_operations.name: literature.amount.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate the existing net_rate and variance_net_rate input meanings from selected source-bound optical observations. Preserve NADH-depletion endpoint scope, actual subject/construct/preparation/conditions, qualified or missing inputs and source-owned covariance. Optical epsilon/path conversion is not recovery k, protein amount, product attribution or a complete activity score. Repeated representations create no independent evidence or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.optical.populate

child_population_operations.description: Read source-bound reported Km, kcat or catalytic-efficiency estimates and populate native parameter, difference, ratio and log-contrast components for separately assayed substrates. Preserve actual molecule/construct, per-row protocols, qualifications and source uncertainty meanings. This native route has no covariance/model source reader; model-dependent evidence cells are not supported here, which is not a finding that the paper lacks covariance. No quotient of reported means, common-condition correction, intrinsic-affinity inference, target transfer or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.kinetic.populate

child_population_operations.description: Read four selected original-image binding cells for two separately assayed source molecular forms and two ligands. Populate native IC50 or reported Hill-fit Kd parameters, within-form ligand ratios and their interaction/log interaction. Preserve actual source meanings, physical-fit identity, uncertain or conflicting readings, units, limits and partial uncertainty; unknown common kind retains raw results without choosing a default. Covariance/model source reading is unimplemented here, not a finding about the paper. No intrinsic-affinity conversion, target transfer or annotation credit.
